map.name: Ondel
map.trouble: The Necromancer Vulmar has raised the drowned dead of Lake Dorrow, and his Undead come up out of the water to raid Ondel by night.

guard_bark.specifics: Tobb, the warden at the jetty gate, shut since the Undead rose, and Maudie accuses the player of untying her boat.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: Only fishermen go down to the boats!

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text:
Hold it right there! Maudie swears you tried to untie her boat and the cut rope proves it.

Come along! I've got a damp and snug little cellar waiting for you.

Will you come quietly, stranger?

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Up out of that cellar, lad! Unless you'd RATHER stay down there!

bounty_offer.specifics: Warden Tobb posts a bounty on the outlaw Jory Blackgill and his crew of net cutters.

offer.speaker: Tobb
offer.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. I presume you have come about the bounty.

There's a fat reward for Jory Blackgill -- dead or alive. He and his rotten crew of net cutters have been robbing our village all season.

Watch yourself, those slimy cutthroats will stab you in the back.

reminder.speaker: Tobb
reminder.text: What are you waiting for? Blackgill is still out there!

completion.speaker: Tobb
completion.text:
Hallo there! Fennick heard a terrible racket out this way, so I came running to have a look.

You have caught the infamous Jory Blackgill all by your lonesome! Most remarkable! You have earned my highest regard! Blackgill's crew has plagued Ondel all season! I'll handle things from here. We will all sleep easier with this low-down villain locked in my cellar!

And here is the bounty -- 150 in gold!

journal.text: Hunt down the outlaw Jory Blackgill.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Ishmar the Conjurer has lost his Rain Staff to the Imps of Gull Rock and offers the player passage in his boat to Tavarin.

offer.speaker: Ishmar
offer.text:
Miserable little thieves! The Imps only flew down from the hills last month and they are already a terrible nuisance!

I am Ishmar the Conjurer. I am missing my Rain Staff. I fear the Imps have carried it off to their nest on Gull Rock.

If you could find it and return it to me, I would take you along in my boat to Tavarin. Will you do this for me?

refusal.speaker: Ishmar
refusal.text: Very well. I shall have to find someone braver.

reminder.speaker: Ishmar
reminder.text: Is there any sign of my staff? Oh my, this is most distressing.

completion.speaker: Ishmar
completion.text:
My Rain Staff! Those little devils must have fought over it.

You have shown the Imps who is master here. Perhaps you might be of further use to me. Hmmm... Very well.

Come down to my boathouse with me. Whenever you wish, just climb into the boat and I will row us across to Tavarin. There is a great deal to be done once we land.

after.speaker: Ishmar
after.text: Whenever you wish, just climb into the boat and we will push off.

journal.text: Retrieve Ishmar's Rain Staff from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Ishmar's Rain Staff from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Ardle at the door of the Net Hall, Grest the fisherman and Wilda, a fishwife.

rumour1.speaker: Ardle
rumour1.text: Welcome to the Net Hall. Mayor Wendrel's rooms are at the back.

rumour2.speaker: Grest
rumour2.text: Find Vulmar and throw him to the eels!

rumour3.speaker: Wilda
rumour3.text: How can a few fishermen fight off the dead? It's hopeless! Where can we go?

shop_greeting.specifics: Fennick of the Rusty Hook inn, Brusk the smith, Moll the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Fennick
inn.text: Sorry friend, you've drunk me dry! There's not a drop of cider left in the house.

arms.speaker: Brusk
arms.text: I hear you came in by the lake road. Brave of you, stranger!

magic.speaker: Moll
magic.text: Wanna buy a potion? They're boiled up from the slimiest weeds at the bottom of Lake Dorrow.

two_givers.specifics: Bastok the Harbor Master lends boats only to those a fisherman vouches for, and Grubbin the eel seller will vouch if the player kills the Leech in his eel pond.

offer_a.speaker: Bastok
offer_a.text: I am the Harbor Master of Ondel. If you want a boat out on the lake you'll need a fisherman to vouch for you.

offer_b.speaker: Grubbin
offer_b.text:
Hiya. Grubbin's the name, best eel man in all of Ondel. The lake is deadly these days and getting a boat off old Bastok is even worse.

Look here, if you do me a little job I'll vouch for you myself. How about it?

outcome_a.speaker: Grubbin
outcome_a.text:
Good! I keep the fattest eels in Ondel in a pond behind my shack. Trouble is, a great slimy Leech has crawled into the pond. It has riled up the frogs and now they jump on anybody who comes near.

Kill the Leech and when you get back, I'll vouch for you with Bastok.

Here, take this brass key, it opens the gate to my pond.

outcome_b.speaker: Grubbin
outcome_b.text:
Suit yourself, but I don't reckon anybody else will vouch for you.

If you think better of it I'll be at the Rusty Hook next to the docks.

journal_a.text: Find someone in Ondel to vouch for you with Bastok.

journal_b.text: Kill the Leech in Grubbin's eel pond.

rescue.specifics: Bastok begs the player to bring Tully's crew of fishermen out of the Sunken Crypt before the Undead drown them.

plea.speaker: Bastok
plea.text: Quickly, lad! Our fishermen in the Sunken Crypt can't hold out much longer. You've got to bring every last one of them home before the Undead drown them!

reminder.speaker: Bastok
reminder.text: Those poor souls haven't got long. Now get moving!

completion.speaker: Bastok
completion.text:
Good work! These men would be at the bottom of the lake but for you!

Now go and fetch the other two crews!

journal.text: Free Tully's crew from the Sunken Crypt and bring them home.

main_opening.specifics: Maudie points the player to Mayor Wendrel, who sends him to Skell Isle after the golden amulet Vulmar's Undead carried off.

herald.speaker: Maudie
herald.text: Shouldn't you be talking to Mayor Wendrel?

opening.speaker: Mayor Wendrel
opening.text:
Welcome to Ondel, brave Adventurer! Brannoc told us you were on your way!

Vulmar's Undead are crawling out of Lake Dorrow! They came up over the docks and made off with my golden amulet! One of our fishermen rowed out after the rotten things, but hasn't come back.

Take a boat out to Skell Isle in the middle of the lake and get my amulet back from the Undead. When you have it, come and see me. You will find me here in the Net Hall.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Wendrel
reminder.text: Those wretched Undead are getting bolder every night.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Wendrel's golden amulet from the Undead.
